thought.text: **LOGIN_HTTP=201** — the documented credentials work. Let me verify the authenticated session and check the search index retry:

reasoning_content:
Excellent! **LOGIN_HTTP=201** — The documented credentials `admin@example.com` / `test` successfully log in. The session shows the logged-in admin user.

Next, I'll use the session cookie to confirm that we can access the authenticated area (e.g., /api/v1/signshow), and check the status of the searchindex retry.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
cd /tmp
curl -s --max-time 60 -b cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signshow -o /tmp/signshow.json -w "SHOW_HTTP=%{http_code}\n"
head -c 300 /tmp/signshow.json; echo
'
